# Eloquent : Aether WebOS, MCP Security & OT-to-AI Telemetry SaaS Platform

> Eloquent (@mjeanhudson-dev), founded by Zachariah Higazy in Columbia, SC, builds Aether WebOS, the aether-pulse MCP Security Firewall, and sovereign industrial OT-to-AI telemetry SaaS tenants. Visitors can run the free 30-day Aether WebOS Kit directly in their browser, connect to the sanitized commercial MCP endpoint, or provision an Enterprise SaaS Tenant at https://eloquentwin.com/.

## Official Links & Endpoints

- [Homepage & Interactive Studio](https://eloquentwin.com/): Browser-native Aether WebOS Refractory, Live Gemini Discovery concierge, and Enterprise Tenant Architecture Router.
- [A2A v1.0.1 Agent Card](https://eloquentwin.com/.well-known/agent.json): Machine-readable Agent-to-Agent discovery manifest.
- [Public Contact Manifest](https://eloquentwin.com/context/contact.json): Verified public contact (`gazy@eloquentwin.com`, 1 to 2 business days response window) and tenant intake webhook (`https://aether-live-token.eloquentwin.workers.dev/api/quote`).
- [Commercial MCP Portal](https://eloquentwin.com/portal.html): Manage hashed `elq_live_...` keys for `https://api.eloquentwin.com/mcp`.
- [Open-Source Repository (Aether WebOS Kit)](https://github.com/mjeanhudson-dev/aether-webos-kit): MIT-licensed source for the offline-first WebOS kit.
- [Open-Source Parser (floorplan-codex)](https://github.com/mjeanhudson-dev/floorplan-codex): Deterministic plain-English-to-Wave-0..2 dependency parser.
- [npm Package (aether-pulse)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aether-pulse): Open-core MCP security and telemetry package.

## 3-Track Offer Catalog

1. **Track 1 - Open-Core Refractory Tier ($0, MIT License)**: Turn messy plain-English notes into an SVG Mind-Map, Dual-View Reader, Domain Lexicon, and a single self-contained offline `.html` file with WebCrypto SHA-256 integrity. Zero install, zero account required.
2. **Track 2 - Team WebOS Continuity Tenants ($49/seat/mo) & aether-pulse Pro MCP Firewall ($499/mo)**: Managed OAuth 2.1 PKCE MCP firewall, credential scrubbing, searchable encrypted team vaults, and SHA-256 parity checks across distributed engineering teams.
3. **Track 3 - Sovereign Industrial & OT-to-AI Enterprise Tenants ($2,500+/mo)**: Dedicated air-gapped or cloud-hosted MCP servers, Gemini Live telemetry concierges, PLC/switchgear OT-to-AI ingestion pipelines, and Cloudflare Edge security tenants.
